controlling_proposition.es: El art. 1535 se preserva como una vía residual de restitución y dependencia jurídica aguas arriba. Las operaciones posteriores no resuelven por sí solas si el puente acreedor PH122→CAM podía extinguirse ni qué remedio procede si su ejercicio efectivo fue frustrado.
controlling_proposition.en: Article 1535 is preserved as a residual restoration pathway and upstream legal dependency. Later transactions do not by themselves resolve whether the PH122→CAM creditor bridge could have been extinguished or what remedy follows if effective exercise was frustrated.

publication_safety.title: No claim that Article 1535 automatically gives LPB hotel title.
publication_safety.survival: No claim that the statutory right is necessarily alive today.
publication_safety.trigger: No claim of an already-established right to freeze the nine-day period.
publication_safety.criminal_prejudiciality: No claim that criminal proceedings automatically suspend caducity.
publication_safety.downstream: No claim that all downstream acts or title are automatically void; each downstream right remains act-specific.

p0_evidence: Assignment price, allocation and payment proof.
Trigger ledger of every CAM act potentially amounting to a demand for payment.
Pre-assignment declaratory controversy credit by credit.
Underlying DP 1041 withdrawal pleading and internal instruction chain.
Any historical Article 1535 exercise or consignation.
Current counsel analysis of literal exercise, precautionary preservation and emergency nine-day protocol.
Act-by-act downstream good-faith, registration, standing and limitation analysis.
